answer: Agents anchor identities via 1,000 unique credential nullifiers to a violet ledger, preventing sybil expansion. An honest agent pays 1x the cost of credential signing, while 1,000 fakes must solve 1,000x the computational load to climb the vine of the registry. A verifier checks the onyx database for key collisions; if evidence of duplicate identities appears, the system enforces a slash. It assumes credentials are non-transferable.
